explicit_constraints: Require an audience claim in each token.
config_source:
session:
  lifetime: 2h
  rotate_on_privilege_change: true
cookie:
  secure: true
  http_only: true
  same_site: Strict
  max_age: 2h
token:
  lifetime: 10m
  signing: required
  algorithm: ES256
  allowed_algorithms:
    - ES256
  denied_algorithms:
    - none
    - HS256
  require_audience_claim: true

session:
  lifetime: 8h
  rotate_on_authentication: true
cookie:
  secure: true
  http_only: true
  same_site: Lax
  max_age: 8h
token:
  lifetime: 15m
  signing: required
  algorithm: RS256
  allowed_algorithms:
    - RS256
  denied_algorithms:
    - none
    - HS256
  refresh_token_reuse: reject
